types.explanation: DAAP defines the /server-info request URI as a distinct operation; the method is always GET, so the request-target is the discriminator.
DAAP defines the /content-codes request URI as a distinct operation for retrieving content code metadata.
DAAP defines /login as the request type for starting a session.
DAAP defines /logout as the request type for ending a session.
DAAP defines /update as the request type for retrieving the current library revision number.
DAAP defines this request-target pattern for returning all songs in a database; [num] is a numeric database ID placeholder.
DAAP defines this request-target pattern for returning all playlists in a database; [num] is a numeric database ID placeholder.
DAAP defines this request-target pattern for returning items within a playlist; the [num] placeholders are numeric database and container IDs.
DAAP defines /resolve as a distinct request type used for resolving playback targets.
